greeting: A wide-open Saturday, Dan — just the Black Keys at midday on the calendar and the girls with Jen this week. The clear hours are a good moment to clear the travel bookings that keep sliding.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The Pathfinder heads south this month, leaving no six-seater in Maine for Christmas. A refundable full-size SUV out of PWM is the hardest holiday rental in that market — the note on it says book this week.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break destination
needsAttention.detail: Three weeks for six people over the holidays is the thinnest inventory of the year. The decision was due Sept 30 and the booking window closes Oct 15 — five days out.

needsAttention.title: Set the Pathfinder drive dates
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 off-week gap is the window to drive Portland to St Pete, and today sits right in it. Firm dates let you book the one hotel night.

needsAttention.title: Arrive at the Sunday review ready
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow's 9 AM with Mike clears the board. Have a view on what's active this week and what's slipped three Sundays running — the Christmas rental and the December trip both qualify.
